Tide business bank account review – £50 cashback
November 19, 2026November 12, 2026 • Business Banking
One of your first tasks when starting a business is to set up a business bank account.
Here we look at the features of Tide’s business current account, which offers £50 cashback for eligible ByteStart visitors.
When you open a current account, you can open a business savings account at the same time. Tide offers competitive interest rates on business savings, depending on the account and plan you choose.
A separate account for your business
If you run a limited company, it is a distinct legal entity in its own right, so you should keep the company’s finances separate from your own.
You should open a dedicated company account.
If you’re a sole trader, there’s no legal requirement to open a separate business account, although having one makes it much easier to keep your business and personal finances apart.
Read more in our guide to using a personal bank account for business.
What features do you need in a bank account?
Most small businesses now use online accounting software – it makes life so much easier to keep on top of your accounts. Most banks now integrate with the leading software providers, such as Xero.
Make sure your bank account can synchronise! Otherwise, you’ll have to upload statements manually, which is a pain.
There are other factors to consider that will influence your choice of bank account. Does your business:
Trade outside the UK?
Need access to a business manager?
Have a lot of monthly transactions?
Need to deposit cash and/or cheques?
Whatever type of business you run, make sure you read our guides to choosing a limited company bank account and choosing a sole trader account.
The Tide business bank account
Business banking has been transformed over the past few years; it has never been simpler to open and run an account.
One of the leading names in business banking is Tide, which now has over 1.5m customers in the UK (as of January 2026).
Tide’s business account is an attractive option if you’re starting a limited company or setting up as a sole trader.
Here are some of the main features:
The free account, as the name suggests, has no monthly or annual fee.
Includes a Mastercard to help pay for expenses.
Transfers between Tide accounts are free.
A simple 20p fee per transaction, with five free transfers per month on the Free plan.
Simple set-up. You can be up and running in minutes.
Eligible deposits are protected by the FSCS, up to £120,000 per eligible depositor per authorised firm.
£50 cashback for eligible ByteStart visitors, subject to Tide’s offer conditions.
More features of the Tide business account
Here are some of the benefits you will enjoy as a Tide customer.
Tide integrates with leading accounting software providers, including QuickBooks, Xero and Sage.
Manage your account from any platform – mobile, tablet or desktop.
No annual or monthly fees on the Free plan.
Company formation services are available if you’re starting a limited company.
Free Mastercard, with additional cards available on some paid plans.
Free transfers to other Tide accounts.
Easily manage your expenses via the app – making VAT returns simple.
Get support via the Tide app.
You can pay in cash (for a fee) at Post Office and PayPoint locations.
If you are a Tide business account holder, you can also open a Tide savings account and earn interest on your spare funds.
Apple Pay and Google Pay are supported.
Tiered pricing – is it worth paying a monthly fee?
Like many other challenger banks, Tide has tiered pricing.
If you have many monthly transactions, a paid account might be more cost-effective than the free option.
Free / Lite
No monthly fee, a business Mastercard, five free transfers per month and in-app support. Further transfers generally cost 20p each.
Smart (£12.49 per month)
Includes 30 free monthly transfers and additional banking features and support.
Pro (£27.49 per month)
Includes unlimited standard UK bank transfers and additional features for businesses with more frequent transactions.
Max (£69.99 per month)
Includes the Pro benefits, additional services and cashback on eligible card spending.
These are the advertised monthly prices at the time of updating. See Tide’s current pricing for full details.
5 steps to opening a new account
Go to our partner page on the Tide site.
Download the Tide app from the Play Store or the App Store.
Submit information about your business (such as its address and what it does).
Verify your identity by providing your ID and taking a selfie.
Most accounts can be opened within minutes!
Tide may require further information before approving an application.
The £50 cashback offer is subject to Tide’s current eligibility and qualifying spending conditions.
Tide also has a business savings account
Alongside the current account, Tide also offers competitive interest rates on its business savings accounts.
All you need to do is set up a Tide business account using this link, and you’ll also have the chance to open an instant saver account.
Savings rates are variable, so check the latest rate before applying.
For more information, read our guide to business savings accounts.
If you have many monthly transactions, a paid Tide account might work out cheaper than the free option. If you regularly pay in cash or need branch access, it’s worth comparing Tide with the high street banks.
You can also read our reviews of ANNA Money and Zempler Business Go.
